summary: AppTech Payments Corp. filed Form 8-K to disclose a $500,000 promissory note with the Suzanne D. Lord Spousal Estate Reduction Trust, a related party (the Chairman serves as trustee). The 9.0% note matures in 90 days, with no amortization and prepayment permitted without penalty. This is a routine short-term working capital borrowing, not a special situation. The board approved the related-person transaction. No special-situation mechanics apply; watch only for repayment at maturity, but the filing lacks deal terms for any transformation event.
